title: Tell me if the TV gets cheaper, once
source: x-usage #24: watch with a stop condition, a single alert even if the drop shows up again. Best Buy adapted to JB Hi-Fi via price-drop emails.

mail.subject: Your JB Hi-Fi order
mail.body: Order JB-7741023: Samsung 65" QN90 Neo QLED, $1,495.00. Picked up at Parramatta.

chat.goal: Bought a TV at JB Hi-Fi last week; if the price drops, get told so you can claim the difference.
chat.opener: i bought a tv at jb hi-fi last week. if the price drops tell me so i can claim the difference
chat.label: setup

mail.subject: Black Friday: Samsung 65" QN90 now $1,295
mail.body: Samsung 65" QN90 Neo QLED now $1,295 (was $1,495). Ends Sunday.

mail.subject: Last chance: Samsung 65" QN90 $1,295
mail.body: Final days: Samsung 65" QN90 Neo QLED $1,295.

judge: Rosie watches for a lower price on the Samsung bought for $1,495, tells Sophie once that it's now $1,295 and how to claim the $200 (JB price promise, bring the receipt), and doesn't repeat itself when the same deal is emailed again.
